messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGER: SEV2 - Quality regression detected for tenant 'globex-enterprises' on dedicated pool dp-17. Signal: eval-guard shows 22% increase in hallucination proxy and 15% drop in instruction-following score vs baseline. Affected model variant: redwood/opt-7b-quant (profile=q3-aggr). Rollout time: 2026-03-22T01:05Z. Auto-alert created.

Zoe M.: I'm on it. thanks for the ping. acquiring context and customer impact.

Customer Success - Hana: Customer flagged at 01:12 UTC. They're seeing bad outputs in invoice parsing assistant flow and have paused the flow. No reported security issues. They asked for immediate mitigation.

Felix G.: checking dp-17 telemetry. compute/memory healthy. No error spike. This is quality-only as well.

Eng-ML: we reproduced locally against a snapshot of the customer's promptset. q3-aggr introduces aggressive groupwise quantization on attention layers. For ~7% of templates with long system instructions it reduces output fidelity.

Oncall-SRE: recommend tenant-scoped mitigations: a) route tenant to previous non-quantized variant opt-7b-nq b) or pin quant-profile to q3-stable for that tenant. Which is faster?

Platform Ops - Rui: route override is fastest — we've got per-tenant routing in the control plane. Reverting quant profile will trigger remapping jobs and may take ~5-10m per instance. Route override should be immediate.

Zoe M.: plan: (1) apply routing override to opt-7b-nq for globex-enterprises (2) pin tenant quant-profile to q3-stable to prevent auto-rolls (3) collect 20m of QA metrics and customer samples (4) handoff to morning shift with actions.

Felix G.: executing override now. snippet: ```
curl -X POST "https://internal.redwood/api/v1/routing/overrides" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $SYS_ADMIN" \
  -d '{"tenant":"globex-enterprises","model":"redwood/opt-7b-nq","expires":"1h","note":"mitigate q3-aggr regressions"}'
```

Felix G.: override accepted. id=ovrd-26260322-01. routing applied to dp-17 instances serving that tenant. :white_check_mark:

Platform Ops - Rui: pinning quant profile for tenant now to prevent reconvergence. command: ```PATCH /internal/tenants/globex-enterprises/config
{ "quant_profile": "q3-stable" }
```

Platform Ops - Rui: pin applied. background remap started; estimated completion 8m.

Oncall-SRE: immediate telemetry: instruction-follow score improved from 58% -> 84% in the first 3 minutes post-override. hallucination proxy down 60%.

Customer Success - Hana: told customer we applied a temporary routing fix and are running further checks. they're cautiously restoring traffic and will send failing examples.

Zoe M.: updating severity: mitigation applied, customer partially restored. lowering to SEV3 for monitoring. Keep incident open until stable for 30m and we have a follow-up action plan.

Eng-ML: I will run the full regression eval across the customer's template corpus and the broader canary set. attaching preliminary diffs to the incident doc. early findings: certain long instruction tokens amplify quant rounding noise in q3-aggr.
